run_generate_creative_creatures: run the script to generate creative creature images from initial doodle strokes using pretrained DoodlerGAN models
run_generate_all_sketches: run the script with --generate_all to process all initial strokes in the dataset folder sequentially
generate_part: generate a creature body part like eyes or wings from a partial sketch using a trained conditional UNet model
generate_truncated: generate images with truncated noise in W-space using a style mapping network and generator with bitmap features
gs_to_rgb: convert a grayscale sketch tensor to RGB by applying a named color from the COLORS dictionary
